title: 4 Stickers Made AI Misread a Stop Sign
topic: Researchers placed a few black-and-white stickers on a stop sign; a vision model read it as a speed-limit sign in most test frames. Humans just see graffiti.
audience: Everyday phone/PC/internet/game/AI-chat users who have seen this themselves
whyCare: Strong frame-0 image; competitors tiny. Lab classifier, not a specific car brand.
